video.description:
Learn to explain how an app changes settings from a server and tests two versions: Remote Config, Fallback Value & A/B Test, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Remote Config - A service that sends settings to your app from a server, so you can change them without an update.
Fallback Value - A safe value the app uses when the server value is missing or has not arrived yet.
A/B Test - An experiment that shows two versions of a feature to different groups of users to see which works better.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Remote Config, Fallback Value & A/B Test in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Remote Config, Fallback Value, A/B Test 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Remote Config - A service that sends settings to your app from a server, so you can change them without an update.
한국어: Remote Config: 서버에서 앱으로 설정을 보내 주어 업데이트 없이 값을 바꿀 수 있게 하는 서비스

Fallback Value - A safe value the app uses when the server value is missing or has not arrived yet.
한국어: Fallback Value: 서버 값이 없거나 아직 도착하지 않았을 때 앱이 쓰는 안전한 값

A/B Test - An experiment that shows two versions of a feature to different groups of users to see which works better.
한국어: A/B Test: 기능의 두 가지 버전을 서로 다른 사용자 그룹에 보여 주어 어느 쪽이 더 좋은지 보는 실험

landscape.hook: Can you explain Remote Config, Fallback Value and A/B Test in English?

dialogue.title: No update needed
dialogue.setting: Changing the retry count from a server

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, can we change the retry count without an app update?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, use remote config. Remote config sends settings to the app from a server.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the server says five retries, and the app obeys?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. The app fetches the remote config when it launches.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if the phone is offline, and the fetch fails?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then `retries` uses a fallback value. In our code, the fallback value is three.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So a fallback value is the safe default?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Never leave a setting empty. The app must work with the fallback value alone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Marketing also wants to test two checkout buttons.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then run an A/B test. Half of the users see one button, and half see the other.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And remote config decides who sees which one?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. We compare the results of the A/B test and keep the winner.

dialogue.code:
let remote: [String: Int] = [:]
let retries = remote["retries"] ?? 3
print(retries)
